title: Final Potential Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric potential V throughout space.

title: Final Electric Field (r >> a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the electric field components E_r and E_theta for r much greater than a.

title: Final Electric Field (r << a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the electric field components E_r and E_theta for r much less than a.

title: Use of Conformal Mapping
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of conformal mapping and its application to the problem.

title: Electric Field Lines Sketch
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a sketch of the electric field lines to illustrate the field distribution.

title: Boundary Conditions Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply boundary conditions to determine constants in the potential expression.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the electric field calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
